case_name: Haji Saeed Khan and Others v State of Uttar Pradesh and Others

statutes.act: Act Was Issued Within The Time Limit Prescribed Under Section 6 Of The Act

facts: A notification under Section 4 (1) of the Land Acquisition Act was issued on 30.3.1995.
A local publication was made on 17.5.1996 and the Notification was published in two newspapers on 19.5.1996 and on 21.5.1996, in the locality.
Thereafter, two corrigenda, one on 26.3.1996 and another on 1.8.1996 were also issued.
In respect of the second corrigendum, there was local publication on 10.2.1997.
A declaration under Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act was made in the Gazette on 18.12.1997.
issues: The interpretation of Sections 6 and 17 (4) of the Land Acquisition Act
petitioner_arguments: Some questions were raised by the learned senior counsel for the appellants
respondent_arguments: Learned Additional Solicitor General relied upon certain decisions of this Court to contend that these contentions raised by the appellants could not be accepted.
court_reasoning: The Court suggested that the date of issue of Section 4 (1) Notification is shifted from 30.3.1995 to 15.6.1998, for purposes of fixing the market value of the land owned or possessed by the appellants before us.
holding: The judgment of the High Court is modified to the limited extent that the land acquisition proceedings which have taken in this case are upheld, will be finalised on the basis of Section 4 (1) Notification issued on 15.6.1998 and possession which is with the Government and now with the Town Planning Authority is confirmed and is not disturbed.
cases_cited: Haji Saeed Khan and Others v State of Uttar Pradesh
upon the decision of this Court in Ram Chand and others v. Union of India
